StringQuestText:200141: Irene says she has big news for us
StringQuestText:304011:
The detector picked up heavy Ashen Creature activity deep in the ruins ahead.
If we don't deal with it now, they'll grow into a horde.
Take out the spawn point before they gather!
StringQuestText:304012:
Bad news: the "Source" in that area is more active than expected.
A wave of mutated Ashen Creatures is already spreading outward.
Clear out the core area before they break through the line.
StringQuestText:304013:
This target is tricky: a cluster that has already mutated.
It's surrounded by Ashen Creatures; normal firepower can barely get close.
It'll be a tough fight, but you should be fine.
StringQuestText:304014:
Alert! Extremely unstable energy detected. The Source is about to erupt!
Cut their link to the Grey Zone right now.
Move fast and end the fight before the energy goes out of control!
StringQuestText:304021:
The signal relay here keeps getting interference and its efficiency has dropped a lot.
The technicians say Ashen Creatures nearby are chewing the cables.
Please clear the area so the base station can work normally again.
StringQuestText:304022:
Observation Tower 3's power core is rebooting and its shield will be down meanwhile.
Ashen Creatures are sensitive to energy surges; they'll swarm in for sure.
For these few minutes until the reboot finishes, the tower's safety is in your hands.
StringQuestText:304023:
We need to set up a temporary beacon on this high ground to extend our view.
Setting it up takes a while and may be a bit noisy.
Hold the position and keep everything away from the equipment!
StringQuestText:304024:
Damn, the purifier's filter is clogged and stability is dropping fast!
If it isn't fixed now, the whole area will be contaminated.
Cover the repair team and destroy every Ashen Creature that comes close!
StringQuestText:304031:
We got a distress call: a rookie exploration team got lost on the way back.
They're low on oxygen and supplies. It doesn't look good.
You're closest. Can you go bring them back?
StringQuestText:304032:
A transport vehicle broke down and is stuck at the edge of the grey fog.
Highly aggressive mutants were spotted there and they won't hold out long. It's urgent: go support them now and keep them alive!
StringQuestText:304033:
An important researcher got separated from their escort while collecting samples.
He is carrying a critical data drive. Nothing can go wrong.
Find him and escort him safely to the extraction point.
StringQuestText:304034:
Our outpost was ambushed and communications just went dark.
It's our last foothold in the area. We can't lose it.
Get the people inside out, whatever it takes!
StringQuestText:304041:
Records show some undamaged memory chips were left in this old district.
There are lots of Ashen Creatures there, but the Research Department really needs that data.
Could you sneak in and quietly bring them out?
StringQuestText:304042:
We need a special crystal to upgrade the Skycart's engine.
It only grows deep in the most contaminated tunnels.
Collecting it may draw out something big. Be careful.
StringQuestText:304043:
A lost airdrop supply crate landed at the edge of the rift.
The terrain is treacherous and flying Ashen Creatures circle the area.
A job for someone agile: you. Please.
StringQuestText:304044:
A special request: we need to recover an "Old Core" that is still running.
Its radiation keeps drawing in monsters, so moving it will be very hard.
Ready for impact? This is a big job.
StringQuestText:304051:
An unreadable black zone has appeared at these map coordinates.
It isn't an Ashen Creature signal, and it isn't terrain.
Go take a look, even if you only bring back a photo.
StringQuestText:304052:
Gravity readings around here have been off lately. Walking feels floaty.
We suspect a special mutant is disrupting the magnetic field. Find the source and eliminate it, or nobody can move.
StringQuestText:304053:
Strange spores fill the air. Breathe in too many and you will hallucinate.
Find the mother spreading them before your suit's filter runs out.
Be quick, and don't let the hallucinations cloud your judgement.
StringQuestText:304054:
Since you're over there, could you test our new detector for me?
Just carry it around these marked points.
It may attract some curious Ashen Creatures, but that's part of the test!
StringCollectItemText:10299011: A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
As a kid Mr. Li loved fishing but was terrible at it. That is why every 100 baits now cost 1,000 fishing rods.
StringCollectItemText:10299012: A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
As a kid, going from level 70 to 80 meant beachcombing all year round. He still insists on it, so he got beaten up.
StringCollectItemText:10299013: Mr. Li's Tape: Mr. Li's Monologue
A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.

The first time I touched an 8-bit console as a kid, I knew I would make my own game one day. After more than ten years at big studios, I started my own company seven years ago. Sticking with it has been really hard. But giving up would be even harder. If you can hear this, you are still here with us. There is a lot left to fix and a lot of new content to make. We will keep working to make the game better, bit by bit. Thank you for always being here, and I hope you will still be here in the future.
StringCollectItemText:10299014: A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
Which dish needs 12 bottles of soy sauce and 12 of salt? The saltiest thing Mr. Li ate as a kid: seafood soup.
StringCollectItemText:10299015: Mr. Li's Tape: Trash in the Sea
A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
Why is there only trash in the sea? Because as a kid Mr. Li pretended the dump outside his house was the ocean and swam around in it alone.
StringCollectItemText:10299016: Mr. Li's Tape: More Yarn Balls
A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
Hey, know why failing can sometimes give you more yarn balls? Mr. Li studied dark alchemy as a kid.
StringCollectItemText:10299017: A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
As a kid Mr. Li stood on a stool to reach something and took a big fall because his balance was terrible. So the worse a weapon's balance, the more often it does super-low damage.
StringCollectItemText:10299018: Mr. Li's Tape: Lemon Floor Lamp
A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
The floor lamp Mr. Li made for his home as a kid was made of lemons.
StringCollectItemText:10299019: Mr. Li's Tape: Cabinet Door Blocks WiFi
A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
As a kid Mr. Li found that opening his cabinet door knocked out WiFi for the whole building.
StringCollectItemText:10299020: A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
As a kid Mr. Li got his hair dyed at a shady salon. It took ten tries to get the color he wanted once.
StringCollectItemText:10299021: Mr. Li's Tape: Ammo and Stamina
A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
Playing with a slingshot as a kid, Mr. Li found his ammo count depended on his constitution.
StringCollectItemText:10299022: A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
As a kid, Mr. Li had to take a potion before he could fit into a little dress.
StringCollectItemText:10299023: Mr. Li's Tape: Four Bottles of Salt, Three of Oil
A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
An ordinary meal takes four bottles of salt and three of oil, because Mr. Li lived through a famine as a kid.
StringCollectItemText:10299024: A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.
Crafting at 75% success and half of them fail? Hmph. Mr. Li's math was taught by the PE teacher.
StringCollectItemText:10299025: Mr. Li's Tape: Never Learned B
A mysterious tape with a certain company boss's embarrassing childhood stories.

StringHelp:1007: Event: 1. Trick-or-Treat Candy Hunt: Deep in the courtyard are three candies glowing with a strange light, said to be the ghosts' dearest treasures: Green Candy Purple Candy Orange Candy They are all hidden behind the event stage bosses, waiting for brave Salvagers to find them! 2. The Mysterious Ghost Badge: Collect all three candies to make a Colorful Candy Bag! Open it for a Ghost Badge, the only currency for event rewards! 3. Challenge! "Netherworld Courtyard": Every day the event screen gives you 2 Event Stage Challenge Tickets from the ghosts: their invitation to play! The ghosts hide in the courtyard; their glow and sounds help you find them. When you find one, open your profile at the top left, take out the camera and snap! Freeze their panicked faces! Photographed ghosts shyly drop their power-up items and run. Each item has its own powerful effect to help you beat strong enemies! Tip: every item has surprising effects. Experiment and find your favorite way to catch ghosts! Note: after each boss reward, the challenge ticket vanishes in a puff of smoke. 4. Gifts under the Wishing Tree: Take your Ghost Badges to the Wishing Tree in the top-left menu. They say the ancient tree spirit answers wishes for badges with exclusive Halloween gifts! So, got your courage and your camera ready? This Halloween, let's go ghost-hunting together!
